blocks.text:
Upon arrival in Rio de Janeiro, transfer to your hotel. Rio has green hills, blue sky, beautiful bays, islands and marvellous beaches: Brazil’s second-largest city after São Paulo and one of the most beautiful in the world. Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon are famous for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where people play football and volleyball on the golden sand from early morning until late at night.

For those who enjoy an active holiday, Rio offers almost any sport, from golf, tennis and surfing to diving and hang-gliding; beach cafés serve refreshing coconut water and freshly squeezed juices, and local musicians often play on the beach.
